hook.zh: 下單 API 回應時間飆到 8 秒，5xx 一直往上爬。
hook.en: Order API latency hits 8 seconds and 5xx errors keep climbing.

text.zh: 下單 API p99 延遲 8.2 秒（SLO 500 ms）
text.en: Order API p99 latency 8.2 s (SLO 500 ms)

text.zh: 5xx 比例 23%
行情推播服務記憶體 78%
官網 CDN 命中率降到 88%
text.en: Website CDN hit rate down to 88%

ask.zh: 先看哪裡？
ask.en: Where do you look first?

label.zh: 看監控儀表板
label.en: Open the dashboards

say.zh: API 機器 CPU 15%、記憶體正常；資料庫連線數卡在 100/100，資料庫 CPU 92%。
say.en: API hosts: CPU 15%, memory fine. Database connections pinned at 100/100, database CPU 92%.

label.zh: 看下單服務的 log
label.en: Read the order service logs

say.zh: 滿滿都是 Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms：連線池裡的連線全被佔住，新請求拿不到。
say.en: Wall-to-wall "Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms": every pooled connection is taken and new requests can't get one.

label.zh: 直接重啟下單服務
label.en: Restart the order service

say.zh: 重啟後 5xx 降到 0……8 分鐘後又回到 25%。連線池重新開始是空的，很快又被同一批東西塞滿。
say.en: After the restart 5xx drops to zero... and is back at 25% eight minutes later. The pool starts empty and fills up with the same thing again.

label.zh: 先處理行情推播的記憶體告警
label.en: Deal with the market-data memory alert first

say.zh: 記憶體在正常範圍內波動，跟這次的 5xx 無關。告警不是每一則都重要。
say.en: Memory is moving within its normal range and has nothing to do with the 5xx. Not every alert matters.

label.zh: 先把下單服務從 4 台擴到 12 台
label.en: Scale the order service from 4 to 12 instances first

say.zh: 新機器各自開了連線池，可是資料庫的連線早就滿了，新機器跟著一起排隊。
say.en: Each new instance opens its own pool, but the database's connections are already full, so the new ones just join the queue.

label.zh: 先暫停下單 API，止住錯誤
label.en: Pause the order API to stop the errors

say.zh: 錯誤不再增加了，但所有人都不能下單，客服電話馬上湧進來。原因還沒找到。
say.en: The errors stop growing, but nobody can place orders and the support lines light up. You still don't know the cause.

ask.zh: 連線池滿了。下一步？
ask.en: The pool is full. Next?

label.zh: 到資料庫看正在跑的查詢（processlist、慢查詢紀錄）
label.en: Look at the queries running in the database (processlist, slow query log)

say.zh: 有 80 條一模一樣的查詢，各跑了 30–60 秒：SELECT … FROM trades WHERE DATE(created_at) = '…'，來自凌晨 3:00 開始的「每日交易對帳報表」排程。
say.en: 80 identical queries, each running 30–60 s: SELECT … FROM trades WHERE DATE(created_at) = '…', from the daily trade reconciliation report that starts at 3:00 a.m.

label.zh: 叫醒 DBA
label.en: Wake up the DBA

say.zh: DBA 過了 7 分鐘才接起電話：「你看一下 processlist，我猜是 3 點的對帳報表。」你一看，果然是。
say.en: The DBA picks up after seven minutes: "Check the processlist, I bet it's the 3 a.m. reconciliation report." It is.

label.zh: 把連線池從 100 調大到 300
label.en: Raise the pool from 100 to 300

say.zh: 改設定、重新部署花了 6 分鐘。結果資料庫 CPU 衝到 100%，所有查詢都變慢，5xx 反而升到 40%，你又花 4 分鐘改回來。連線池滿是症狀，不是原因。
say.en: Changing the config and redeploying takes six minutes. Database CPU hits 100%, every query slows down, 5xx climbs to 40%, and you spend four more minutes reverting. A full pool is the symptom, not the cause.

label.zh: 把資料庫切到備援機（failover）
label.en: Fail the database over to the standby

say.zh: 切換時斷線 40 秒，新的主庫一上線，報表排程照樣把它塞滿。
say.en: The switch drops connections for 40 seconds, and the report job fills the new primary just the same.

ask.zh: 找到了：對帳報表的慢查詢。怎麼止血？
ask.en: Found it: the report's slow queries. How do you stop the bleeding?

label.zh: 先暫停報表排程，再 kill 掉這些慢查詢
label.en: Pause the report job first, then kill the slow queries

say.zh: 連線數掉到 18/100，p99 回到 180 ms，5xx 歸零。
say.en: Connections fall to 18/100, p99 is back to 180 ms, 5xx at zero.

label.zh: 直接 kill 掉慢查詢
label.en: Just kill the slow queries

say.zh: 連線數掉下來了……3 分鐘後排程自動重試，又塞滿了。來源沒停，砍再多都會回來。
say.en: Connections drop... and three minutes later the job retries and fills them again. Until the source stops, they keep coming back.

label.zh: 現在就幫 trades 表加索引
label.en: Add an index to trades right now

say.zh: 上億筆的表，建索引跑了 20 分鐘，期間還吃掉資料庫的 CPU 和 IO，止不了血。索引是事後的根治，不是現在的止血。
say.en: On hundreds of millions of rows the index takes 20 minutes to build and eats database CPU and IO the whole time. An index is the cure for later, not the tourniquet for now.

label.zh: 把報表排程改到唯讀副本跑，再 kill 掉慢查詢
label.en: Move the report job to the read replica, then kill the slow queries

say.zh: 改設定、重新部署排程服務花了 8 分鐘。之後報表從副本跑，下單恢復正常，今晚的報表也照樣產出。
say.en: The config change and redeploy take 8 minutes. The report now runs on the replica, orders recover, and tonight's report still gets made.

label.zh: 重啟資料庫
label.en: Restart the database

say.zh: 資料庫重啟 6 分鐘，所有連線中斷、下單全掛；起來之後報表排程重試，又塞滿了。
say.en: The restart takes six minutes with every connection dropped and all orders failing; once it's up, the report job retries and fills it again.

ask.zh: 連線數降下來了。這樣就算好了嗎？
ask.en: Connections are down. Is that it?

label.zh: 盯著下單成功率和 p99 再看 5 分鐘
label.en: Watch the order success rate and p99 for another 5 minutes

say.zh: p99 穩在 180 ms，成功率 99.9%。只是剛剛那段時間有 3,200 筆下單失敗，有些用戶可能自己重送過。
say.en: p99 holds at 180 ms and the success rate at 99.9%. But 3,200 orders failed during the incident, and some users may have resent them.

label.zh: 看起來好了，直接回去睡
label.en: Looks fine. Back to bed

say.zh: 你沒再看一眼就睡了。5 點報表排程的重試又跑了一次，把連線池塞滿；白天值班的同事被叫起來收拾，失敗的下單也沒人處理。
say.en: You go to sleep without another look. At five the report job's retry runs again and fills the pool; the day shift is called in to clean up, and nobody deals with the failed orders.

label.zh: 請客服看看有沒有新的客訴
label.en: Ask support whether new complaints are coming in

say.zh: 客服 8 分鐘後才回覆：新的客訴停了，倒是有幾位用戶在問自己的單是不是下了兩次，這段時間裡又有幾筆重複的單成交了。
say.en: Support replies 8 minutes later: new complaints have stopped, but a few users ask whether their order went in twice, and a few more duplicates filled in the meantime.

label.zh: 保險起見，把連線池從 100 調到 150
label.en: Raise the pool from 100 to 150 just in case

say.zh: 改設定、重新部署，下單又抖了一下，多了幾十筆失敗。連線池大小從來不是問題。
say.en: The config change and redeploy make orders stumble again, with a few dozen more failures. The pool size was never the problem.

ask.zh: 收尾：剛剛失敗的 3,200 筆下單。
ask.en: Clean-up: the 3,200 orders that failed.

label.zh: 撈出失敗後又被用戶重送的單，確認有沒有重複掛單，再通知受影響的用戶
label.en: Find the failed orders users resent, check for duplicates, and notify those affected

say.zh: 有 41 筆重複掛單，你在成交前撤掉多的那張，並逐一通知用戶。
say.en: There are 41 duplicate orders; you cancel the extra ones before they fill and notify each user.

label.zh: 在狀態頁公告：凌晨下單服務異常約 20 分鐘，已恢復
label.en: Post on the status page: the order service failed for about 20 minutes and has recovered

say.zh: 公告發了，但重複的掛單沒人處理，早上有 12 位用戶發現自己買了兩倍。
say.en: The notice is up, but nobody handles the duplicates; in the morning 12 users find they bought twice.

label.zh: 把失敗的下單全部自動重送一次
label.en: Automatically resend every failed order

say.zh: 系統替用戶重送了 3,200 筆單，其中很多人早就自己重下過，現在變成三張。
say.en: The system resends 3,200 orders, and many users had already placed theirs again; now there are three.

cause.zh: 凌晨 3:00 的對帳報表用了 DATE(created_at) = ?，函式包住欄位讓索引失效，每條查詢都掃整張表。80 條同時跑，把資料庫連線全部佔住，下單 API 拿不到連線就逾時。
cause.en: The 3 a.m. reconciliation report filters on DATE(created_at) = ?. Wrapping the column in a function stops the index from being used, so every query scans the whole table. Eighty of them at once held every database connection, and the order API timed out waiting for one.

todo.zh: 查詢改成 created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?，讓索引用得上
todo.en: Rewrite the filter as created_at >= ? AND created_at < ? so the index applies

todo.zh: 報表改到唯讀副本跑，不跟下單搶連線
todo.en: Run reports on a read replica, away from order traffic

todo.zh: 批次工作的查詢設逾時，跑太久就直接中斷
todo.en: Give batch queries a timeout so runaway ones are cut off

lesson.zh: 連線池滿是症狀，不是原因：先找出是誰佔住連線，停掉來源止血，再回頭根治。
lesson.en: A full pool is a symptom, not a cause: find who is holding the connections, stop the source, then fix it properly.

hook.zh: 今天的交易返佣，發了平常的兩倍。
hook.en: Tonight's trading rebates went out at twice the usual amount.

text.zh: 每日返佣發放總額 2.0 倍（平常 ±5%）
客服信箱：「我的返佣怎麼多了一倍？」
text.en: Support inbox: "Why did my rebate double?"

text.zh: 推播服務佇列長度 1,200

ask.zh: 先做什麼？
ask.en: What do you do first?

label.zh: 看排程的執行紀錄
label.en: Check the job's run history

say.zh: 00:00:00 在 worker-1 跑了一次，00:00:01 在 worker-2 又跑了一次。上週為了扛行情的流量，worker 從一台擴成兩台。
say.en: It ran on worker-1 at 00:00:00 and again on worker-2 at 00:00:01. Last week the workers were scaled from one to two for market traffic.

label.zh: 回滾昨天的部署
label.en: Roll back yesterday's deploy

say.zh: 昨天的部署只改了前端文案，回滾完返佣還是多的。不是每個事故都是最近一次部署造成的。
say.en: Yesterday's deploy only changed some front-end copy; after the rollback the rebates are still doubled. Not every incident comes from the latest deploy.

label.zh: 馬上寫 SQL 把多發的返佣扣回來
label.en: Write SQL to claw the rebates back right now

say.zh: 你用「今天有兩筆返佣的用戶」當條件扣回，結果把今天剛好有兩筆合法返佣（例如邀請獎勵）的用戶也一起扣了，客服信箱炸開。補救之前要先算清楚範圍。
say.en: You deduct from "users with two rebates today" and also hit everyone who legitimately got two, referral rewards included. The support inbox explodes. Work out the scope before you repair anything.

label.zh: 先把所有人今天的返佣歸零，明天重發
label.en: Zero everyone's rebate for today and pay it again tomorrow

say.zh: 多發的確實拿不走了，但合法的返佣也一起消失，客服信箱炸開。
say.en: The extra can't be taken any more, but the legitimate rebates vanish too, and the support inbox explodes.

label.zh: 在事故頻道問有沒有人動過返佣
label.en: Ask in the incident channel whether anyone touched rebates

say.zh: 凌晨十二點半，十分鐘過去，沒有人回。
say.en: Half past midnight. Ten minutes pass and nobody answers.

ask.zh: 為什麼兩台都會跑？
ask.en: Why did both machines run it?

label.zh: 看排程是怎麼寫的
label.en: Read how the job is scheduled

say.zh: 排程寫在應用程式裡，每台機器各自觸發，沒有分散式鎖，發放也沒有冪等鍵。一台的時候沒事，兩台就各跑一次。
say.en: The schedule lives in the application, so every machine fires it. No distributed lock, no idempotency key on the payout. Fine with one machine; with two, each runs it once.

label.zh: 叫醒寫這支排程的同事
label.en: Wake the engineer who wrote the job

say.zh: 同事過了 10 分鐘回電：「啊……當初預設只會有一台。」
say.en: Ten minutes later they call back: "Oh... we assumed there'd only ever be one."

label.zh: 把排程改成只在 worker-1 跑，重新部署
label.en: Make the job run only on worker-1 and redeploy

say.zh: 部署完才想到：這只顧得到明天，今天多發的還在；而且 worker-1 一掛，返佣就不發了。
say.en: Only after the deploy does it hit you: this only covers tomorrow, today's extra is still out there, and if worker-1 dies no rebates go out at all.

ask.zh: 先擋住、再補救。下一步？
ask.en: Contain it, then repair it. Next?

label.zh: 先暫停返佣的提領和交易使用
label.en: Freeze rebate balances from withdrawal and trading for now

say.zh: 多發的返佣不會再被用掉或提走了。只是所有人的返佣都暫時不能用，客服多了一些詢問。
say.en: The extra rebates can't be spent or withdrawn any more. Everyone's rebates are frozen for now, though, and support gets more questions.

label.zh: 停掉今晚的排程，撈出「同一用戶、同一天、同一種返佣」的重複紀錄，先 dry-run 算人數
label.en: Stop tonight's job, find duplicates by user, day and rebate type, and dry-run the count

say.zh: 12,034 位用戶各多了 3 USDT，其中 1,820 位已經拿去交易或提走一部分。名單確定了，排程也不會再重試。
say.en: 12,034 users got 3 extra USDT each; 1,820 have already traded or withdrawn some. The list is settled and the job won't retry.

label.zh: 把 worker-2 關掉就好
label.en: Just shut down worker-2

say.zh: 明天不會再跑兩次了，但今天多發的返佣還在，而且只剩一台，明天的行情尖峰扛不住。
say.en: It won't run twice tomorrow, but today's extra rebates are still out there, and one machine won't survive tomorrow's market peak.

label.zh: 直接跑扣回腳本，不先 dry-run
label.en: Run the reclaim script straight away, no dry run

say.zh: 跑完才發現：有 340 位用戶今天本來就有兩筆合法返佣，也被扣了；名單得重撈一次。
say.en: Afterwards you find 340 users who legitimately had two rebates today were debited too; the list has to be rebuilt.

ask.zh: 已經被用掉的返佣怎麼處理？
ask.en: What about rebates that were already used?

label.zh: 用掉的不追回，其餘扣回，並發公告說明
label.en: Leave what was used, reclaim the rest, and post a notice

say.zh: 扣回腳本照 dry-run 的名單跑完，數字對得上。公告寫清楚是系統錯誤、已用掉的不追回，客服照著回覆。公司吞下已被用掉的那一部分。
say.en: The reclaim script runs against the dry-run list and the numbers match. The notice says it was our error and used rebates stay used; support replies from it. The company absorbs what was spent.

label.zh: 全部扣回，扣到變負數也沒關係
label.en: Reclaim everything, even into a negative balance

say.zh: 1,820 位用戶的返佣餘額變成負的，客服電話整晚沒停。錯是我們犯的，代價不該讓用戶扛。
say.en: 1,820 users now show a negative rebate balance and the support line rings all night. The mistake was ours; users shouldn't pay for it.

label.zh: 全部追回，用掉的從之後的返佣分期扣，並發公告說明
label.en: Reclaim it all, taking what was spent from future rebates, and post a notice

say.zh: 公告寫清楚是系統錯誤、用掉的部分分期扣回。有人不滿，但公司幾乎沒有損失。
say.en: The notice says it was our error and spent rebates come out of future ones in instalments. Some are unhappy, but the company loses almost nothing.

ask.zh: 止血了。但下一次 00:00，兩台 worker 還會各跑一次排程。
ask.en: Contained. But at the next midnight both workers will run the job again.

label.zh: 先把 worker-2 的排程開關關掉，分散式鎖等上班再加
label.en: Turn off the scheduler flag on worker-2 for now; add the distributed lock in office hours

say.zh: 只剩 worker-1 會觸發排程，下一次不會重複發。真正的修法留給白天有人 review 的時候。
say.en: Only worker-1 will fire the job, so the next run won't double up. The real fix waits for daytime and a review.

label.zh: 交給白天的人，不另外處理
label.en: Leave it to the day team and do nothing more

say.zh: 交接訊息淹沒在早上的頻道裡，沒人處理；隔天 00:00 返佣又發了兩次。
say.en: The handover message drowns in the morning channel and nobody acts; at the next midnight rebates go out twice again.

label.zh: 現在就寫分散式鎖、部署上線
label.en: Write the distributed lock now and deploy it

say.zh: 凌晨寫完直接上線，沒有人 review。部署時兩台 worker 輪流重啟，返佣頁面錯誤了幾分鐘。鎖是加上了，但這種改動應該白天做。
say.en: Written and shipped at night with no review. The workers restart in turn during the deploy and the rebate page errors for a few minutes. The lock is in, but this belongs in daytime.

ask.zh: 最後收尾：
ask.en: Finally:

label.zh: 對帳：確認每個人的返佣餘額正確，有凍結的話一併解除，再給客服回覆範本
label.en: Reconcile every rebate balance, lift any freeze, and give support a reply template

say.zh: 對帳數字吻合，凍結解除，客服照著範本回覆。
say.en: The numbers match, the freeze is lifted, and support replies from the template.

label.zh: 直接收工，對帳交給明天的日報表
label.en: Call it a night and leave the check to tomorrow's daily report

say.zh: 日報表早上才跑出來：扣回腳本漏了 140 人，他們把多的返佣也提走了；凍結也一路掛到中午。
say.en: The daily report arrives in the morning: the reclaim script missed 140 users, who withdrew the extra too, and any freeze stays on until noon.

label.zh: 對帳之後解除凍結，客服回覆等上班再說
label.en: Reconcile and lift the freeze; support replies can wait for office hours

say.zh: 帳是對的，但客服早上面對幾百封信，沒有統一的說法。
say.en: The books are right, but support faces hundreds of emails in the morning with no agreed wording.

cause.zh: 每日返佣的排程寫在應用程式裡，沒有分散式鎖，發放也沒有冪等鍵。上週 worker 從一台擴成兩台，兩台在 00:00 各跑了一次。
cause.en: The daily rebate job lives in the application with no distributed lock and no idempotency key on the payout. Last week the workers went from one to two, and at midnight each ran it.

todo.zh: 排程加分散式鎖（例如 ShedLock，或 Redis 的 SET NX），同一時間只讓一台跑
todo.en: Add a distributed lock (ShedLock, or Redis SET NX) so only one machine runs it

todo.zh: 發放紀錄加唯一鍵（用戶 + 日期 + 返佣類型），重跑也不會重複發
todo.en: Put a unique key on payouts (user + date + type) so a rerun can't double up

todo.zh: 擴容檢查表加一項：有沒有只能跑一次的工作
todo.en: Add "anything that must run only once?" to the scale-out checklist

lesson.zh: 擴容會打破「這段只會跑一次」的假設：排程要有鎖，寫入要冪等；補救前先 dry-run，範圍算清楚再動手。
lesson.en: Scaling out breaks "this only runs once": jobs need a lock, writes need to be idempotent, and repairs need a dry run before anything changes.

hook.zh: Redis 例行升級重啟後，資料庫 CPU 衝到 100%。
hook.en: After a routine Redis upgrade and restart, database CPU hits 100%.

text.zh: 資料庫 CPU 100%
行情頁（K 線、深度）p99 6.1 秒，5xx 15%
Redis 命中率 0%
郵件服務退信率 2%
客服：App 一直轉圈，用戶說看不到行情
text.en: Support: the app keeps spinning, users can't see prices

ask.zh: Redis 剛重啟完，資料庫就爆了。先做什麼？
ask.en: Redis just restarted and the database is melting. First move?

label.zh: 看資料庫在忙什麼
label.en: See what the database is busy with

say.zh: 九成是同一支「交易對資訊」查詢，熱門交易對每秒被查幾百次。快取全部同時變空，所有請求一起回源，這就是快取雪崩（cache stampede）。
say.en: Ninety percent is one trading-pair info query, with popular pairs fetched hundreds of times a second. The whole cache emptied at once and every request went to the source together: a cache stampede.

label.zh: 再重啟一次 Redis
label.en: Restart Redis again

say.zh: 快取又空了一次，情況一模一樣。Redis 沒壞，壞的是「所有東西同時沒有快取」。
say.en: The cache empties again and nothing changes. Redis isn't broken; the problem is that nothing is cached at the same time.

label.zh: 緊急把資料庫升級到更大的規格
label.en: Upgrade the database to a bigger instance now

say.zh: 升級要 20 分鐘，中間切換時還斷線 30 秒。等它升完，你早該用別的方法止血了。
say.en: The upgrade takes 20 minutes and drops connections for 30 seconds during the switch. You should have stopped the bleeding some other way long before it finished.

label.zh: 把流量全部切到備援機房
label.en: Fail all traffic over to the standby region

say.zh: 切過去才發現備援機房的 Redis 前天也升級過，一樣是冷的。
say.en: Once it's over you find the standby region's Redis was upgraded the day before and is just as cold.

label.zh: 清掉 CDN 快取
label.en: Purge the CDN cache

say.zh: CDN 一清，連靜態資源都回源，情況更糟。
say.en: With the CDN purged even static files go back to origin, and it gets worse.

ask.zh: 怎麼先讓資料庫喘口氣？
ask.en: How do you give the database room to breathe?

label.zh: 開啟限流，先關掉「熱門幣種排行」「公告輪播」這些非核心功能
label.en: Turn on rate limiting and switch off non-essentials like the trending list and the announcement carousel

say.zh: 資料庫 CPU 降到 70%，下單和提幣恢復正常，行情頁還是偏慢。先保住最重要的路徑。
say.en: Database CPU drops to 70%, orders and withdrawals work again, market pages are still slow. Protect the critical path first.

label.zh: 把 API 逾時從 3 秒調成 10 秒
label.en: Raise the API timeout from 3 s to 10 s

say.zh: 請求等得更久、佔住的連線更多，資料庫前面排的隊更長。逾時調長只會讓塞車更嚴重。
say.en: Requests wait longer, hold more connections, and the queue in front of the database grows. A longer timeout only makes the jam worse.

label.zh: 把 API 從 6 台擴到 20 台
label.en: Scale the API from 6 to 20 instances

say.zh: API 變多，打進資料庫的查詢跟著變多，CPU 更滿。
say.en: More API instances send more queries to the database, and its CPU fills further.

label.zh: 讓行情頁改讀唯讀副本
label.en: Point the market pages at the read replica

say.zh: 改設定花了 7 分鐘。副本分擔了讀取，資料庫 CPU 降到 75%，行情頁還是偏慢。
say.en: The change takes 7 minutes. The replica takes some reads, database CPU falls to 75%, market pages are still slow.

ask.zh: 讓快取回來：
ask.en: Bring the cache back:

label.zh: 用腳本預熱交易量最大的 200 個交易對
label.en: Warm the 200 busiest trading pairs with a script

say.zh: 命中率回到 85%，資料庫 CPU 降到 35%，p99 回到 250 ms，非核心功能逐一打開。
say.en: Hit rate back to 85%, database CPU at 35%, p99 at 250 ms. The non-essentials come back one by one.

label.zh: 什麼都不做，等快取自己慢慢長回來
label.en: Do nothing and let the cache refill on its own

say.zh: 25 分鐘後命中率才慢慢回到八成。修好了，但這段時間都在用降級模式撐。
say.en: Twenty-five minutes later the hit rate creeps back to 80%. It's fixed, but you ran degraded the whole time.

label.zh: 預熱全部 2,000 個交易對
label.en: Warm all 2,000 trading pairs

say.zh: 預熱腳本自己就打了資料庫 2,000 次，前三分鐘反而更慢；跑完之後命中率 95%。
say.en: The warm-up itself hits the database 2,000 times, so the first three minutes get slower; afterwards the hit rate is 95%.

ask.zh: 命中率回來了。之前的降級措施怎麼收？
ask.en: The hit rate is back. How do you unwind the fallbacks?

label.zh: 一個一個打開非核心功能、放寬限流，每一步看一下資料庫 CPU
label.en: Turn the non-essentials back on one at a time and relax the rate limit, watching database CPU after each

say.zh: 每開一個就看一眼，全部打開後資料庫 CPU 穩在 40%。
say.en: You check after each one; with everything back on, database CPU holds at 40%.

label.zh: 全部一次打開
label.en: Turn everything back on at once

say.zh: 全部同時打開，熱門幣種排行的快取還是冷的，資料庫 CPU 又衝到 95%，你趕緊關回一半，慢慢來。
say.en: With everything on at once, the trending list's cache is still cold and database CPU jumps to 95%; you switch half of it off again and go slowly.

label.zh: 限流和降級先留著，早上再說
label.en: Leave the limits and fallbacks on until morning

say.zh: 早上交易量一上來，限流擋掉了不少正常用戶的請求，熱門排行也空了一整個早上。
say.en: When the morning volume arrives, the rate limit turns away plenty of real users, and the trending list stays empty all morning.

ask.zh: 收尾：
ask.en: Clean-up:

label.zh: 更新狀態頁、在事故頻道寫下時間軸，提醒白天：Redis 升級前要先預熱、分批重啟
label.en: Update the status page, write the timeline in the incident channel, and note for the day team: warm up and restart in batches before any Redis upgrade

say.zh: 早上的人一看就懂發生了什麼，也知道下次升級要怎麼做。
say.en: The morning team understands what happened at a glance, and knows how to do the next upgrade.

label.zh: 什麼都沒寫，回去睡
label.en: Write nothing and go to bed

say.zh: 早上大家看著告警紀錄一頭霧水，有人又重啟了一次 Redis 想「確認一下」，快取又空了一次。
say.en: The morning team stares at the alert history, puzzled; someone restarts Redis again "to check", and the cache empties once more.

label.zh: 順手把快取到期時間加上隨機值，現在部署
label.en: While you're at it, add jitter to cache expiry and deploy now

say.zh: 半夜改快取邏輯上線，部署重啟時行情頁又抖了一下。是對的改動，但應該在白天、有人 review 時做。
say.en: Changing cache logic at night makes the market pages stumble again during the deploy. The right change, but one for daytime with a review.

cause.zh: Redis 重啟後快取全部變空，熱門交易對的請求同時回源到資料庫。快取平常替資料庫擋掉九成以上的讀取，一拿掉，資料庫就扛不住。
cause.en: The restart emptied the cache, and requests for popular pairs all went to the database at once. The cache normally absorbs over 90% of reads; without it the database couldn't cope.

todo.zh: 快取到期時間加隨機值（jitter），避免大量 key 同時過期
todo.en: Add jitter to expiry times so keys don't expire together

todo.zh: 熱門 key 回源加互斥（single-flight），同一個 key 只放一個請求去查資料庫
todo.en: Single-flight the refill: one request per key goes to the database

todo.zh: Redis 升級改用副本切換，不讓快取整個清空；真的要清空前先預熱
todo.en: Upgrade Redis by failing over to a replica instead of emptying it, and warm up before any planned flush

lesson.zh: 快取不只是加速，它也在替資料庫擋流量。拿掉之前，先想好誰來擋。
lesson.en: A cache doesn't just speed things up; it shields the database. Before you remove it, know what will take the load.

hook.zh: 成交通知延遲 40 分鐘，consumer lag 一直漲。
hook.en: Trade notifications are 40 minutes late and consumer lag keeps rising.

text.zh: trade-notify consumer lag 48,000，持續上升
客服：成交了卻沒收到通知
text.en: Support: users aren't getting fill notifications

text.zh: 某條鏈的節點同步延遲 3 個區塊
text.en: A chain node is 3 blocks behind

text.zh: 風控服務 GC 停頓 200 ms

ask.zh: 先做什麼？
ask.en: What do you do first?

label.zh: 看 consumer 的 log
label.en: Read the consumer logs

say.zh: partition 4 一直在重試同一筆訊息（offset 1,203,377）：JsonParseException: Unexpected character。每次失敗就從頭再來，後面的訊息全部排隊。
say.en: Partition 4 keeps retrying the same message (offset 1,203,377): JsonParseException: Unexpected character. Each failure starts over, and everything behind it waits.

label.zh: 把 consumer 從 3 個加到 12 個
label.en: Scale the consumers from 3 to 12

say.zh: topic 只有 6 個 partition，多出來的 consumer 根本分不到工作；卡住的 partition 4 還是卡住。
say.en: The topic has only 6 partitions, so the extra consumers get nothing to do, and partition 4 is as stuck as before.

label.zh: 重啟 consumer
label.en: Restart the consumers

say.zh: 重啟後從上次 commit 的 offset 繼續，馬上又撞到同一筆壞訊息。
say.en: They resume from the last committed offset and hit the same bad message straight away.

label.zh: 把 topic 的 partition 從 6 個加到 24 個
label.en: Raise the topic's partitions from 6 to 24

say.zh: 新的 partition 只接得到新訊息，卡住的 partition 4 一動也不動；而且同一個用戶的通知從此可能亂序。
say.en: New partitions only get new messages; the stuck partition 4 doesn't move. And one user's notifications can now arrive out of order.

ask.zh: 這筆壞訊息怎麼處理？
ask.en: What do you do with the bad message?

label.zh: 把它送進錯誤佇列（DLQ），commit 跳過
label.en: Send it to the dead-letter queue (DLQ) and commit past it

say.zh: partition 4 開始往下消化，lag 從 52,000 一路下降。壞訊息還在 DLQ 裡，沒有丟。
say.en: Partition 4 starts draining and lag falls from 52,000. The bad message is parked in the DLQ, not lost.

label.zh: 把 consumer group 的 offset 直接重設到最新
label.en: Reset the consumer group's offset to latest

say.zh: lag 瞬間歸零，新的成交通知恢復正常。代價是中間那 52,000 筆通知全被跳過，那些用戶永遠收不到了。
say.en: Lag drops to zero and new fill notifications flow again. The price: the 52,000 in between are skipped, and those users will never get them.

label.zh: 請上游的撮合服務先停止發訊息
label.en: Ask the upstream matching service to stop producing

say.zh: 上游停了，新的成交也跟著沒有通知；而且卡住的那一筆還在原地。
say.en: Upstream stops, so new fills get no notifications either, and the stuck message is still there.

label.zh: 把 consumer 改成解析失敗就略過，直接部署
label.en: Change the consumer to skip anything it can't parse, and deploy

say.zh: 部署花了 8 分鐘，lag 開始下降。只是之後解析失敗的訊息會直接被丟掉，沒有地方留，這一筆的通知也就沒了。
say.en: The deploy takes 8 minutes and lag starts falling. From now on unparseable messages are just dropped with nowhere to go, and this one's notification is gone.

ask.zh: partition 開始消化了，積壓的 52,000 筆通知會一口氣送出去。
ask.en: The partition is draining, and 52,000 backed-up notifications are about to go out at once.

label.zh: 先把推播速率限到每秒 500 筆，慢慢送
label.en: Cap the push rate at 500 a second and let it drain

say.zh: 推播供應商沒被打爆，積壓的通知 15 分鐘內全部送完，新的成交通知也恢復即時。
say.en: The push provider holds up; the backlog is gone within 15 minutes and new fills notify in real time again.

label.zh: 不限速，讓它全部衝出去
label.en: No limit, let it all go

say.zh: 52,000 筆通知幾秒內打出去，推播供應商回了一堆 429，有 9,000 筆送失敗，要再補送。
say.en: 52,000 notifications go out in seconds, the push provider answers with a wall of 429s, and 9,000 fail and must be resent.

label.zh: 先暫停推播，早上再一次送
label.en: Hold the pushes and send them all in the morning

say.zh: 通知全卡到早上，用戶醒來收到一大串幾小時前的成交通知。
say.en: Everything waits until morning, and users wake to a long list of fills from hours ago.

ask.zh: 通知恢復了。DLQ 裡那一筆壞訊息呢？
ask.en: Notifications are flowing. What about the bad message in the DLQ?

label.zh: 壞訊息先留在 DLQ，等上班再查
label.en: Leave the bad message in the DLQ until the morning

say.zh: 壞訊息留在 DLQ。那一筆成交的用戶，要到明天才收得到通知。
say.en: The bad message stays in the DLQ. The user behind it gets their fill notification tomorrow.

label.zh: 查壞訊息從哪來、修好解析，再從 DLQ 重送
label.en: Trace where the bad message came from, fix the parser, and replay it from the DLQ

say.zh: 是上游某個版本把成交數量寫成了「1,200.5」這種帶逗號的字串。解析修好後，從 DLQ 重送那一筆，通知全部補發完畢。
say.en: An upstream release wrote the fill quantity as the string "1,200.5", comma and all. With the parser fixed, the message is replayed from the DLQ and every notification goes out.

label.zh: 叫醒上游撮合組，請他們修好再從 DLQ 重送
label.en: Wake the upstream matching team to fix it, then replay from the DLQ

say.zh: 上游的人 15 分鐘後上線，修好送出端的格式；你從 DLQ 重送那一筆，通知補發完畢。
say.en: The upstream team comes online 15 minutes later and fixes the producer's format; you replay the message from the DLQ and the notification goes out.

ask.zh: 收尾：
ask.en: Clean-up:

label.zh: 發公告說明這段時間的通知會晚到、成交以紀錄為準，並在 DLQ 加上告警
label.en: Post a notice that notifications from this window may be late and fills are as recorded, and add an alert on the DLQ

say.zh: 客服照著公告回覆；之後 DLQ 一有訊息就會通知值班的人。
say.en: Support answers from the notice, and the DLQ now pages whoever is on call.

label.zh: 只在 DLQ 加告警
label.en: Just add an alert on the DLQ

say.zh: 早上客服收到一堆「通知怎麼晚了一小時」的詢問，沒有統一的說法可以回。
say.en: In the morning support gets a pile of "why was my notification an hour late" questions, with no agreed answer.

label.zh: 回去睡
label.en: Back to bed

say.zh: 沒人知道 DLQ 裡之後還會不會有別的壞訊息，下次又是同樣的事；客服早上也沒有說法可以回。
say.en: Nobody will know if more bad messages land in the DLQ, so next time it happens the same way; and support has no answer in the morning.

cause.zh: 上游送出一筆格式錯誤的訊息（數量是帶逗號的字串）。consumer 解析失敗就無限重試同一筆；同一個 partition 內要照順序處理，後面的訊息就全部卡住。
cause.en: Upstream sent a malformed message (the quantity as a string with a comma). The consumer retried it forever, and since a partition is processed in order, everything behind it stalled.

todo.zh: consumer 重試設上限，超過就送 DLQ，不讓一筆訊息卡住整個 partition
todo.en: Cap consumer retries and send failures to the DLQ, so one message can't block a partition

todo.zh: DLQ 要有告警和重送工具，不是丟進去就忘了
todo.en: Alert on the DLQ and give it a replay tool, so nothing is dropped and forgotten

todo.zh: producer 端加 schema 驗證，壞資料一開始就送不出去
todo.en: Validate the schema on the producer so bad data never gets sent

lesson.zh: 一筆壞訊息就能卡住整個 partition：重試要有上限，失敗的要有地方去，不能無限重來。
lesson.en: One bad message can block a whole partition: cap the retries and give failures somewhere to go.

hook.zh: 禮拜五 23:40，法幣通道的到帳通知全部失敗。
hook.en: Friday, 23:40. Every fiat-channel deposit notification is failing.

text.zh: 法幣通道合作夥伴的 webhook 失敗率 100%
外部監控：api.example.com TLS 握手失敗
text.en: External probe: TLS handshake failed for api.example.com

text.zh: 測試環境磁碟用量 85%

ask.zh: 禮拜五晚上，先做什麼？
ask.en: It's Friday night. First move?

label.zh: 用 openssl 看一下憑證
label.en: Inspect the certificate with openssl

say.zh: notAfter 是今天 23:39:59。憑證在一分鐘前過期了。
say.en: notAfter is today at 23:39:59. The certificate expired a minute ago.

label.zh: 打給合作夥伴，請他們清快取再重試
label.en: Call the partner and ask them to clear their cache and retry

say.zh: 對方 10 分鐘後回覆：「我們這邊看到的是 certificate has expired。」
say.en: Ten minutes later they reply: "We're seeing certificate has expired."

label.zh: 回滾今天的部署
label.en: Roll back today's deploy

say.zh: 今天根本沒有部署。禮拜五不部署，這是祖訓。
say.en: There was no deploy today. Nobody deploys on a Friday.

egg.zh: 另外，你去拜了綠色乖乖。
egg.en: Also, you made an offering to the green Kuai Kuai.

label.zh: 先去拜綠色乖乖
label.en: Make an offering to the green Kuai Kuai first

say.zh: 綠色乖乖已經放上機櫃。可惜乖乖只保佑還沒過期的東西。
say.en: A packet of green Kuai Kuai is on the rack. Sadly it only protects things that haven't expired yet.

label.zh: 重啟 API gateway
label.en: Restart the API gateway

say.zh: 重啟後掛上的還是同一張憑證。
say.en: After the restart it serves the same certificate.

label.zh: 先換一張自簽憑證頂著
label.en: Put up a self-signed certificate for now

say.zh: 合作夥伴的系統不信任自簽憑證，握手一樣失敗。
say.en: The partner's system doesn't trust a self-signed certificate, and the handshake still fails.

ask.zh: 憑證過期了。可是今天是禮拜五……
ask.en: The certificate has expired. But it's Friday...

label.zh: 手動跑一次續期
label.en: Run the renewal by hand

say.zh: 續期卡在 DNS 驗證：自動續期用的 API token 三個月前被輪替了，難怪一直沒續上。
say.en: The renewal fails at DNS validation: the API token the auto-renewal uses was rotated three months ago. That's why it never renewed.

label.zh: 回覆合作夥伴：等禮拜一再處理
label.en: Tell the partner it'll be handled on Monday

say.zh: 23:58，合作夥伴的負責人打電話來了：週末的法幣入金全卡著。禮拜五不部署是為了不製造事故，不是為了不修事故。
say.en: At 23:58 the partner's lead calls: every fiat deposit over the weekend is stuck. "No Friday deploys" is about not causing incidents, not about leaving them unfixed.

label.zh: 從備份找上一次的憑證檔重新掛上
label.en: Restore the previous certificate from backup

say.zh: 找到的是三個月前那張，同樣已經過期。
say.en: The one you find is from three months ago, and it has expired too.

label.zh: 直接買一張付費憑證
label.en: Just buy a paid certificate

say.zh: 付款、等 CA 驗證網域，半小時後才拿到新憑證。
say.en: Paying and waiting for the CA to validate the domain takes half an hour before you have a certificate.

ask.zh: 續期要過 DNS 驗證，但 token 失效了。
ask.en: Renewal needs DNS validation, and the token is dead.

label.zh: 到 DNS 服務後台產一把新的 API token，再續期
label.en: Create a new API token in the DNS provider's console and renew

say.zh: 新 token 產好、更新到續期設定，續期成功，拿到新憑證。
say.en: With a new token in the renewal config, the renewal succeeds and you have a new certificate.

label.zh: 叫醒管 DNS 的同事要 token
label.en: Wake whoever manages DNS for a token

say.zh: 同事 12 分鐘後回電，給了你新的 token，續期成功。
say.en: They call back 12 minutes later with a new token, and the renewal goes through.

label.zh: 改用 HTTP 驗證來續期
label.en: Switch the renewal to HTTP validation

say.zh: 改設定、開放驗證路徑花了一點時間，續期成功。只是之後要記得改回來。
say.en: Changing the config and opening the validation path takes a while, then the renewal succeeds. Remember to switch it back later.

label.zh: 把舊的 token 從輪替前的備份裡找回來用
label.en: Dig the old token out of a pre-rotation backup

say.zh: 舊 token 早就被撤銷了，DNS 服務回 401。
say.en: The old token was revoked long ago; the DNS provider answers 401.

ask.zh: 拿到新憑證了。怎麼上線？
ask.en: You have the new certificate. How do you roll it out?

label.zh: 先換一台 gateway，用 openssl 確認憑證鏈正確，再換其餘幾台
label.en: Swap it on one gateway, check the chain with openssl, then do the rest

say.zh: 第一台檢查正常，其餘幾台接著換，TLS 握手全部恢復，合作夥伴的 webhook 開始重送。
say.en: The first one checks out, the rest follow, every TLS handshake succeeds, and partner webhooks start retrying.

label.zh: 所有 gateway 一次換上去
label.en: Swap it on every gateway at once

say.zh: 一次全換，結果憑證鏈少放了中繼憑證，一部分客戶端還是握手失敗；你又花了幾分鐘補上。
say.en: All at once, but the chain is missing the intermediate certificate and some clients still fail; you spend a few more minutes fixing it.

ask.zh: 憑證過期的這段時間，合作夥伴的到帳通知全失敗了。
ask.en: While the certificate was expired, every partner deposit notification failed.

label.zh: 請合作夥伴重送這段時間的 webhook，再對帳確認入金都到了
label.en: Ask the partner to resend this window's webhooks, then reconcile that every deposit arrived

say.zh: 對方重送了 118 筆，對帳全部吻合，入金都補上了。
say.en: They resend 118; reconciliation matches and every deposit is credited.

label.zh: 等對方的重試機制自己補
label.en: Let the partner's retries catch up on their own

say.zh: 對方的重試只試 3 次，有 60 筆早就放棄了，要等禮拜一人工處理，用戶整個週末看不到入金。
say.en: Their retries give up after 3 attempts; 60 deposits were abandoned and wait for Monday, and those users see nothing all weekend.

ask.zh: 最後：
ask.en: Finally:

label.zh: 把「憑證到期監控」和「續期失敗告警」寫進待辦，在事故頻道留下時間軸
label.en: Add certificate-expiry monitoring and renewal-failure alerts to the backlog, and write the timeline in the incident channel

say.zh: 禮拜一的人一看就知道要做什麼。
say.en: Monday's team will know exactly what to do.

label.zh: 禮拜五晚上了，回去睡
label.en: It's Friday night. Back to bed

say.zh: 禮拜一沒人記得這件事；三個月後另一張憑證也用同一把舊 token，又過期了一次。
say.en: By Monday nobody remembers; three months later another certificate on the same dead token expires too.

cause.zh: 自動續期的 job 三個月前就開始失敗：它做 DNS 驗證用的 API token 被輪替了，job 每次都報錯，但只寫在 log 裡，沒人收到通知。憑證一到期，所有 TLS 連線就失敗。
cause.en: The auto-renew job had been failing for three months: the API token it used for DNS validation was rotated, and its errors went to a log nobody read. When the certificate expired, every TLS connection failed.

todo.zh: 監控憑證本身的到期日，剩 14 天就告警
todo.en: Monitor the certificate's own expiry and alert at 14 days

todo.zh: 續期 job 失敗要告警，不能只寫在 log 裡
todo.en: Alert when the renewal job fails, not just log it

todo.zh: 輪替 token 的時候，列出所有用到它的地方
todo.en: When rotating a token, list everything that uses it

lesson.zh: 監控要盯結果（憑證還剩幾天），不是盯過程（續期 job 有沒有跑）。
lesson.en: Monitor the outcome (days left on the certificate), not the process (whether the renewal job ran).

hook.zh: ETH 入金 30 分鐘沒有新的入帳。
hook.en: No ETH deposit has been credited for 30 minutes.

text.zh: ETH 入金 30 分鐘沒有新的入帳
text.en: No ETH deposits credited for 30 minutes

text.zh: 客服：用戶說入金 40 分鐘還沒到帳
text.en: Support: users say deposits haven't arrived after 40 minutes

text.zh: 行情服務 GC 停頓 120 ms
BTC 節點 CPU 70%
客服工單累積 80 筆：入金未到帳
text.en: 80 support tickets now: deposits not credited

ask.zh: 入金卡住了。先看哪裡？
ask.en: Deposits are stuck. Where do you look first?

label.zh: 看入金監聽服務的 log
label.en: Read the deposit listener's logs

say.zh: 監聽服務本身沒報錯，但它讀到的「最新區塊」已經 20 分鐘沒變過了。
say.en: The listener itself reports no errors, but the latest block it sees hasn't changed in 20 minutes.

label.zh: 拿自家節點的區塊高度跟公開的區塊瀏覽器比
label.en: Compare our node's block height with a public block explorer

say.zh: 自家節點落後 380 個區塊，卡在同一個高度不動了。
say.en: Our node is 380 blocks behind and stuck at the same height.

label.zh: 重啟入金監聽服務
label.en: Restart the deposit listener

say.zh: 重啟後還是讀不到新區塊。問題不在監聽服務。
say.en: After the restart it still sees no new blocks. The listener isn't the problem.

label.zh: 叫醒區塊鏈組的同事
label.en: Wake the blockchain team

say.zh: 同事過了 10 分鐘接電話：「先比一下節點高度，八成是節點又卡了。」你一比，落後 380 個區塊。
say.en: Ten minutes later they pick up: "Check the node's height, it's probably stuck again." It's 380 blocks behind.

label.zh: 先處理行情服務的 GC 告警
label.en: Deal with the market-data GC alert first

say.zh: 120 ms 的 GC 停頓在正常範圍，跟入金無關。
say.en: A 120 ms GC pause is within normal range and has nothing to do with deposits.

label.zh: 重新部署入金監聽服務的最新版本
label.en: Redeploy the latest deposit listener build

say.zh: 部署完，監聽服務還是讀不到新區塊。
say.en: After the deploy the listener still sees no new blocks.

label.zh: 先照客服給的交易哈希，手動幫客訴的用戶補入帳
label.en: Credit the complaining users by hand from the hashes support sent

say.zh: 你手動補了 12 筆，其中 2 筆其實還沒達到確認數，帳上多出來的錢之後要追。
say.en: You credit 12 by hand; 2 of them hadn't reached enough confirmations, and that money will have to be chased.

ask.zh: 節點落後 380 個區塊。怎麼讓入金恢復？
ask.en: The node is 380 blocks behind. How do you get deposits moving?

label.zh: 入金監聽改讀備用節點
label.en: Point the listener at the backup node

say.zh: 監聽改讀備用節點，新區塊開始進來，新的入金恢復入帳。
say.en: The listener switches to the backup node, new blocks flow in and fresh deposits are credited again.

label.zh: 等自家節點自己追上
label.en: Wait for our node to catch up

say.zh: 節點一個區塊一個區塊追，25 分鐘後終於追上。這段時間入金照樣卡著。
say.en: The node catches up block by block and gets there 25 minutes later. Deposits stay stuck the whole time.

label.zh: 重啟自家節點
label.en: Restart our node

say.zh: 節點重啟後要重新連上其他節點、重新同步，反而又多落後了一段。
say.en: After the restart the node has to find peers and resync, and falls further behind.

label.zh: 改接第三方節點服務（RPC 供應商）
label.en: Switch to a third-party node provider (RPC)

say.zh: 申請 API key、改設定花了 10 分鐘，入金恢復。只是現在入帳靠的是別人的節點，資安會想知道這件事。
say.en: Getting an API key and changing the config takes 10 minutes, and deposits resume. Crediting now relies on someone else's node, though, and security will want to hear about it.

ask.zh: 新區塊進來了。卡住那段時間的入金怎麼補？
ask.en: New blocks are coming in. How do you credit the deposits from the gap?

label.zh: 從落後的區塊開始重掃，用交易哈希（tx hash）去重後補入帳
label.en: Rescan from where the node stalled, deduplicating by transaction hash

say.zh: 重掃完補上 412 筆入金，用交易哈希去重，一筆都沒有重複。
say.en: The rescan credits 412 deposits, deduplicated by transaction hash, with not one double.

label.zh: 監聽直接從最新區塊開始
label.en: Start the listener from the latest block

say.zh: 中間 380 個區塊裡的入金全被跳過。用戶的錢在鏈上，帳上卻沒有，客服接下來一整天都在一筆一筆處理。
say.en: Every deposit in those 380 blocks is skipped. The money is on chain but not in users' accounts, and support spends the next day fixing them one by one.

label.zh: 從落後的區塊開始重掃，直接補入帳
label.en: Rescan from where the node stalled and credit everything found

say.zh: 重掃補上了，但切換節點時已經處理過的 23 筆又入帳一次。23 筆重複入帳，其中 5 筆已經被提走。
say.en: The rescan credits them, but 23 deposits already handled during the switch are credited again. 23 double credits, and 5 of them have already been withdrawn.

label.zh: 請客服整理客訴名單，一筆一筆手動補
label.en: Have support list the complaints and credit them one by one

say.zh: 客服整理出 60 筆，你一筆一筆補；其他沒客訴的 352 筆，要等明天對帳才找得到。
say.en: Support lists 60 and you credit them one by one; the other 352 that nobody complained about wait for tomorrow's reconciliation.

ask.zh: 補入帳跑完了。怎麼確認？
ask.en: The back-credit has run. How do you check it?

label.zh: 拿這段時間的鏈上入金跟帳上入帳逐筆對帳
label.en: Reconcile on-chain deposits against credits for the whole window, one by one

say.zh: 鏈上和帳上逐筆比對，沒有漏的，也沒有重複的。
say.en: Chain and books match transaction by transaction: nothing missing, nothing doubled.

label.zh: 抽查幾筆客訴的交易就好
label.en: Spot-check a few of the complaints

say.zh: 抽查的都對。隔天的每日對帳才發現還有 3 筆沒補到，那幾位用戶又多等了一天。
say.en: The ones you check are fine. The next day's reconciliation finds 3 more never credited, and those users wait another day.

ask.zh: 入金恢復了，但自家節點還卡著。
ask.en: Deposits are flowing, but our own node is still stuck.

label.zh: 先留在備用節點，讓自家節點重新同步，白天再切回來
label.en: Stay on the backup node, resync our own node, and switch back in the daytime

say.zh: 自家節點開始從頭同步，入金繼續走備用節點。
say.en: Our node starts resyncing from scratch while deposits keep using the backup.

label.zh: 馬上切回自家節點
label.en: Switch back to our own node right away

say.zh: 自家節點根本還沒追上，切回去入金又卡住了 10 分鐘，你只好再切回備用。
say.en: Our node hasn't caught up at all; switching back stalls deposits for another 10 minutes and you switch again.

label.zh: 乾脆把備用節點設成主節點，不切回來了
label.en: Make the backup the primary for good

say.zh: 現在只剩一個節點在跑，沒有第二個來源可以比對，下次它出事就沒有備援。
say.en: Now there's only one node and nothing to compare it against; next time it fails there's no fallback.

ask.zh: 收尾：
ask.en: Clean-up:

label.zh: 給客服回覆範本：入金已補，附上時間範圍與筆數；把節點高度監控寫進待辦
label.en: Give support a reply template (deposits credited, with the window and count) and add node height monitoring to the backlog

say.zh: 客服照著範本回覆，客訴在早上前就清掉了。
say.en: Support replies from the template and the complaints are cleared before morning.

label.zh: 回去睡
label.en: Back to bed

say.zh: 早上客服還在回「入金沒到，請耐心等候」，沒人知道其實早就補了。
say.en: In the morning support is still answering "please be patient", unaware the deposits were credited hours ago.

cause.zh: 自家的 ETH 節點跟其他節點斷了線，停在某個區塊不再前進。入金監聽只讀這一個節點，沒有拿它跟其他來源比對，新區塊進不來，入金也就不入帳。
cause.en: Our ETH node lost its peers and stopped advancing. The deposit listener read only that node and never compared it with another source, so no new blocks came in and no deposits were credited.

todo.zh: 監控節點的區塊高度，跟公開來源或第二個節點比對，落後就告警
todo.en: Monitor the node's block height against a public source or a second node and alert when it falls behind

todo.zh: 入金監聽支援自動切換到備用節點
todo.en: Let the deposit listener fail over to a backup node automatically

todo.zh: 入帳以交易哈希做唯一鍵，重掃幾次都不會重複入帳
todo.en: Key credits by transaction hash so any number of rescans can't double-credit

lesson.zh: 鏈上資料要有第二個來源可以比對；補帳一定要冪等，再趕也不能重複入帳。
lesson.en: On-chain data needs a second source to check against, and back-crediting must be idempotent however rushed you are.

hook.zh: USDT 提幣排了 214 筆，最舊的已經等了 50 分鐘。
hook.en: 214 USDT withdrawals are queued; the oldest has waited 50 minutes.

text.zh: USDT 提幣佇列 214 筆，最舊的等了 50 分鐘
text.en: USDT withdrawal queue at 214, oldest waiting 50 minutes

text.zh: 熱錢包 USDT 餘額低於水位
text.en: Hot wallet USDT balance below threshold

text.zh: 某合作夥伴 API 延遲 900 ms
text.en: A partner API at 900 ms latency

text.zh: K 線服務延遲 1 秒
社群開始出現「交易所提不了幣」的貼文
text.en: Social media posts start saying "the exchange won't let me withdraw"

ask.zh: 提幣卡住了。先做什麼？
ask.en: Withdrawals are stuck. What do you do first?

label.zh: 看提幣服務的 log
label.en: Read the withdrawal service logs

say.zh: 每一筆都回 insufficient balance：熱錢包裡的 USDT 剩 12,000，佇列要 480,000。行情大跌，大家都在提 USDT。
say.en: Every one fails with insufficient balance: the hot wallet holds 12,000 USDT and the queue needs 480,000. The market dropped and everyone is withdrawing USDT.

label.zh: 把卡住的提幣全部重試
label.en: Retry every stuck withdrawal

say.zh: 重試一樣餘額不足，還多送出一輪失敗通知，客服電話更多了。
say.en: The retries fail the same way and send another round of failure notices. More calls to support.

label.zh: 叫醒錢包負責人
label.en: Wake the wallet owner

say.zh: 錢包負責人：「熱錢包被提乾了，要從冷錢包補，得叫醒多簽的簽核人。」
say.en: The wallet owner: "The hot wallet's been drained. Topping it up from cold storage needs the multisig signers."

label.zh: 先把提幣手續費調高，壓一下提幣量
label.en: Raise withdrawal fees to slow withdrawals down

say.zh: 手續費一調，社群馬上有人截圖：交易所想把用戶的錢關在裡面。
say.en: Within minutes someone posts a screenshot: the exchange is trying to keep users' money locked in.

ask.zh: 熱錢包的 USDT 不夠付這批提幣。
ask.en: The hot wallet doesn't hold enough USDT for this queue.

label.zh: 從冷錢包補幣：打電話叫醒多簽的簽核人（5 人中要 3 人）
label.en: Top up from cold storage: call the multisig signers (3 of 5 needed)

say.zh: 兩位簽核人接了電話、上線核准；第三位在國外，說半小時後才能上線。
say.en: Two signers answer and approve; the third is abroad and says it'll be half an hour.

label.zh: 先暫停 USDT 提幣，發公告說明「延遲處理，資產安全」
label.en: Pause USDT withdrawals for now and post a notice: delayed, funds safe

say.zh: 用戶看到公告，知道錢沒事、只是慢，客訴明顯少了。但這只是爭取時間，熱錢包還是空的。
say.en: Seeing the notice, users know their money is safe, just slow, and complaints drop. It only buys time; the hot wallet is still empty.

label.zh: 用熱錢包剩下的 USDT 先處理小額提幣
label.en: Use what's left in the hot wallet for the small withdrawals first

say.zh: 150 筆小額提幣先出去了，大額的還在排隊。
say.en: 150 small withdrawals go out; the large ones keep waiting.

label.zh: 為了快，把冷錢包的私鑰匯入熱錢包系統直接付
label.en: To save time, import the cold wallet's key into the hot wallet system and pay out

say.zh: 提幣全部出去了。但冷錢包的私鑰碰過線上機器，等於不再是冷錢包；資安要求把整批資產搬到新地址，下週整個部門都在處理這件事。
say.en: Every withdrawal goes out. But the cold key has touched an online machine, so it isn't cold any more; security has the whole balance moved to new addresses, and the department spends next week on it.

label.zh: 向合作的做市商借一筆 USDT 先補進熱錢包
label.en: Borrow USDT from a market-making partner to top up the hot wallet

say.zh: 對方 15 分鐘後轉來 300,000 USDT，提幣恢復。這筆借款要付利息，也得盡快還。
say.en: Fifteen minutes later they send 300,000 USDT and withdrawals resume. The loan carries interest and has to be repaid soon.

label.zh: 把其他幣種的熱錢包在市場上換成 USDT 補進來
label.en: Sell other coins from the hot wallets for USDT and top up

say.zh: 大跌時在市場上賣幣，滑價吃掉不少；其他幣種的熱錢包也跟著變薄。
say.en: Selling into a falling market costs a lot in slippage, and the other hot wallets get thinner too.

ask.zh: 冷錢包轉帳還差一位簽核人。
ask.en: The cold wallet transfer needs one more signer.

label.zh: 繼續打給第四、第五位簽核人
label.en: Keep calling the fourth and fifth signers

say.zh: 第五位 10 分鐘後接起電話上線核准，600,000 USDT 從冷錢包轉進熱錢包。
say.en: The fifth signer picks up 10 minutes later and approves; 600,000 USDT moves from cold storage to the hot wallet.

label.zh: 等在國外的那位上線
label.en: Wait for the signer abroad

say.zh: 等了 25 分鐘，第三位上線核准，冷錢包補幣完成。
say.en: After 25 minutes the third signer comes online and approves; the top-up completes.

label.zh: 用管理員權限把門檻暫時降成 2 人
label.en: Use admin rights to lower the threshold to 2 for now

say.zh: 門檻改了，錢也轉了。但這等於任何兩個人就能動冷錢包，資安和稽核一早就找上門，門檻改回來之前每一筆都要重新檢查。
say.en: The threshold drops and the money moves. But now any two people can move the cold wallet; security and audit are at your door first thing, and every transfer is re-checked until it's restored.

ask.zh: 熱錢包有錢了，佇列裡還排著 214 筆提幣。
ask.en: The hot wallet is funded, and 214 withdrawals are still queued.

label.zh: 恢復提幣，按順序出幣，盯著熱錢包水位
label.en: Resume withdrawals in order and watch the hot wallet level

say.zh: 佇列 20 分鐘內清空，熱錢包水位還在安全範圍。
say.en: The queue clears within 20 minutes and the hot wallet stays in its safe range.

label.zh: 一次把佇列全部送上鏈
label.en: Push the whole queue on chain at once

say.zh: 214 筆一起送出，自己把手續費推高，有 30 筆卡在 mempool，又得一筆一筆加速。
say.en: Sending all 214 at once drives up your own fees; 30 get stuck in the mempool and have to be bumped one by one.

label.zh: 大額的先人工審核再出
label.en: Review the large ones by hand before sending

say.zh: 大額提幣多等了半小時；審核沒發現問題，只是多了幾則客訴。
say.en: Large withdrawals wait another half hour; the review finds nothing wrong, just a few more complaints.

ask.zh: 收尾：
ask.en: Clean-up:

label.zh: 更新公告：提幣已恢復，說明延遲原因；把熱錢包水位和簽核輪值寫進待辦
label.en: Update the notice (withdrawals resumed, and why they were delayed) and add hot wallet thresholds and a signer rota to the backlog

say.zh: 社群上的貼文慢慢平息，白天的人也知道要改什麼。
say.en: The social posts quiet down, and the day team knows what to change.

label.zh: 什麼都不說，提幣恢復就好
label.en: Say nothing; withdrawals are back, that's enough

say.zh: 沒有任何說明，社群上「交易所是不是沒錢了」的貼文一直沒停。
say.en: With no explanation, the "is the exchange out of money?" posts keep coming.

cause.zh: 行情大跌時提幣量暴增，熱錢包的 USDT 很快被提乾。從冷錢包補幣需要多位簽核人核准，半夜沒有自動流程，提幣就卡住了。
cause.en: When the market dropped, withdrawals surged and drained the hot wallet's USDT. Topping up from cold storage needs several signers, nothing does it at night, so withdrawals stalled.

todo.zh: 熱錢包水位隨行情波動調整，劇烈波動時提前補幣
todo.en: Adjust the hot wallet threshold with market volatility and top up ahead of big moves

todo.zh: 多簽簽核人排輪值，半夜也有人能核准
todo.en: Put multisig signers on a rota so someone can approve at night

todo.zh: 提幣因餘額不足卡住時，自動暫停並公告，不讓用戶反覆重試
todo.en: When withdrawals stall for lack of funds, pause and announce automatically instead of letting users retry

lesson.zh: 熱錢包放得少是為了安全；缺錢的時候慢一點沒關係，拿安全換速度才是真的出事。
lesson.en: The hot wallet is small for safety. Being slow when it runs dry is fine; trading safety for speed is the real incident.

hook.zh: 3 筆已經入帳的入金，在鏈上找不到了。
hook.en: Three credited deposits can no longer be found on chain.

text.zh: 入金對帳：3 筆已入帳的交易在鏈上找不到
text.en: Deposit reconciliation: 3 credited transactions missing on chain

text.zh: 某條鏈發生 7 個區塊的重組（reorg）
ETH 節點 CPU 75%
客服系統登入變慢
同一條鏈又出現 2 筆可疑的大額入金
text.en: Two more suspicious large deposits on the same chain

ask.zh: 已入帳的入金在鏈上消失了。先做什麼？
ask.en: Credited deposits have vanished from the chain. First move?

label.zh: 查這 3 筆交易和帳戶入帳後做了什麼
label.en: Trace the three transactions and what the accounts did after the credit

say.zh: 3 筆入金來自同一批剛註冊的帳戶，都只等了 3 個確認就入帳。重組之後，原本的交易被另一筆把錢轉走的交易取代——有人在做雙花。其中一個帳戶已經把錢換成 USDT 提走了。
say.en: All three came from a batch of brand-new accounts and were credited after only 3 confirmations. The reorg replaced each with a transaction sending the coins elsewhere: a double spend. One account has already converted to USDT and withdrawn.

label.zh: 直接把這 3 筆的金額扣回來
label.en: Deduct the three amounts straight away

say.zh: 兩個帳戶扣回了，第三個已經提走，扣成負數也追不回來；而且你還不知道攻擊有沒有在繼續。
say.en: Two accounts are debited; the third has already withdrawn, and a negative balance won't bring it back. You still don't know whether the attack is ongoing.

label.zh: 叫醒風控同事
label.en: Wake the risk team

say.zh: 風控同事：「先看這幾個帳戶入帳後做了什麼。」你一查，3 筆都只等了 3 個確認，其中一個已經換成 USDT 提走了。
say.en: The risk lead: "Check what those accounts did after the credit." All three waited only 3 confirmations, and one has already been converted to USDT and withdrawn.

label.zh: 聯絡收款的交易所，請他們凍結被提走的 USDT
label.en: Ask the receiving exchange to freeze the withdrawn USDT

say.zh: 對方客服回覆：需要執法單位的正式公文才能凍結。
say.en: Their support replies that they need a formal request from law enforcement before they can freeze anything.

label.zh: 重啟這條鏈的節點
label.en: Restart the node for that chain

say.zh: 節點重啟後同步到的還是重組後的鏈，那 3 筆交易確實不存在了。
say.en: After the restart it syncs to the reorganised chain; those three transactions really are gone.

ask.zh: 有人在故意雙花。怎麼止血？
ask.en: Someone is double-spending on purpose. How do you stop the loss?

label.zh: 暫停這條鏈的入金與提幣，凍結相關帳戶
label.en: Pause deposits and withdrawals on that chain and freeze the accounts involved

say.zh: 攻擊者沒得玩了。只是這條鏈上的正常用戶也暫時不能出入金。
say.en: The attacker is shut out. Legitimate users of that chain can't move funds for now, though.

label.zh: 只凍結這幾個帳戶，入金照常
label.en: Freeze just these accounts and keep deposits open

say.zh: 這幾個帳戶停住了，但新註冊的帳戶一樣可以照做，損失只止住一部分。
say.en: These accounts are stopped, but a fresh account can do the same thing, so the loss is only partly contained.

label.zh: 跟風控討論後決定等天亮再處理
label.en: Agree with the risk team to deal with it in the morning

say.zh: 等待的這段時間，又有兩筆一樣手法的入金進來。
say.en: While you wait, two more deposits arrive using the same trick.

label.zh: 暫停全站所有鏈的入金與提幣
label.en: Pause deposits and withdrawals on every chain

say.zh: 攻擊確實擋住了，但所有幣種都不能出入金，客服湧入大量詢問。
say.en: The attack is stopped, but no coin can move in or out, and support is flooded.

ask.zh: 止血了。怎麼恢復這條鏈的出入金？
ask.en: Contained. How do you reopen the chain?

label.zh: 把這條鏈的確認數門檻從 3 調到 30，恢復出入金
label.en: Raise the chain's confirmation threshold from 3 to 30 and reopen it

say.zh: 門檻調高後恢復出入金，新的入金要等 30 個確認才入帳。
say.en: With the higher threshold the chain reopens; new deposits wait for 30 confirmations.

label.zh: 直接恢復入金，門檻不變
label.en: Reopen deposits with the threshold unchanged

say.zh: 入金恢復了，門檻沒動。同樣的攻擊，明天還能再來一次。
say.en: Deposits reopen, threshold untouched. The same attack can run again tomorrow.

label.zh: 確認數門檻調到 30，但只套用在新註冊的帳戶
label.en: Raise the threshold to 30, but only for newly registered accounts

say.zh: 老帳戶的入金照舊 3 個確認就入帳；攻擊者下次只要先養一個老帳戶。
say.en: Older accounts still get credited after 3 confirmations; next time the attacker just ages an account first.

ask.zh: 重新對帳：這條鏈最近 24 小時的入金。
ask.en: Reconcile the chain's last 24 hours of deposits.

label.zh: 逐筆比對鏈上狀態和帳上入帳
label.en: Compare every deposit's on-chain status with the books

say.zh: 又找到 1 筆同樣手法、還沒被提走的入金，先凍結扣回。
say.en: You find one more deposit using the same trick, not yet withdrawn, and freeze and reverse it.

label.zh: 只看大額的
label.en: Check only the large ones

say.zh: 小額的那一筆漏掉了，隔天被提走才發現。
say.en: The small one slips through and is withdrawn before anyone notices the next day.

ask.zh: 被提走的那一筆怎麼處理？
ask.en: What about the funds that were withdrawn?

label.zh: 整理證據報案，提供資料給收款的交易所，損失先由公司吸收
label.en: Gather evidence, file a police report, send it to the receiving exchange, and absorb the loss for now

say.zh: 報案與資料都送出了，之後追回多少不一定，但每一步都有紀錄。
say.en: The report and evidence are filed. How much comes back is uncertain, but every step is on record.

label.zh: 金額不大，不報案了
label.en: It's not much. Don't report it

say.zh: 沒有報案紀錄，之後追不回來，也沒辦法跟稽核和保險交代。
say.en: With no report there's no chance of recovery, and nothing to show audit or insurance.

ask.zh: 收尾：
ask.en: Clean-up:

label.zh: 公告這條鏈的入金需要更多確認、到帳會比較慢
label.en: Announce that deposits on this chain now need more confirmations and arrive later

say.zh: 用戶知道入金為什麼變慢，客服也有說法可以回。
say.en: Users know why deposits are slower, and support has an answer.

label.zh: 不公告，回去睡
label.en: No announcement. Back to bed

say.zh: 用戶發現入金變慢，以為交易所出事，客服一早就接到一堆詢問。
say.en: Users notice slower deposits, assume something is wrong, and support is swamped first thing.

cause.zh: 這條鏈的確認數門檻只設 3 個，而它的算力相對低、容易被重組。攻擊者先入金、等 3 個確認入帳、換成別的幣提走，再用重組把原本的入金交易換掉。
cause.en: The chain's confirmation threshold was only 3, on a chain whose low hash rate makes reorgs cheap. The attacker deposited, got credited after 3 confirmations, converted and withdrew, then used a reorg to replace the original deposit.

todo.zh: 確認數門檻依每條鏈的安全性設定，算力低的鏈要等更多確認
todo.en: Set confirmation thresholds per chain by its security; low-hash-rate chains wait for more

todo.zh: 監控重組事件，發生重組時自動暫停該鏈的入帳
todo.en: Watch for reorgs and pause crediting on a chain automatically when one happens

todo.zh: 新帳戶的大額入金先延遲可用，或加強審查
todo.en: Delay or review large deposits from new accounts before they become usable

lesson.zh: 確認數不是越少越好：入帳要等到這條鏈「翻不過來」為止。
lesson.en: Fewer confirmations isn't faster, it's riskier: credit only once the chain can't be rewritten.

hook.zh: BTC 指數價格一分鐘內跌了 18%。
hook.en: The BTC index price falls 18% in one minute.

text.zh: BTC/USDT 指數價格 1 分鐘內 -18%
閃兌（convert）BTC 成交量 12 倍
K 線服務延遲 2 秒
推播服務佇列長度 3,000
有帳戶連續用閃兌低價買進 BTC 並提走
text.en: Accounts are buying cheap BTC through convert and withdrawing it

ask.zh: 價格一分鐘跳了 18%。先做什麼？
ask.en: The price moved 18% in a minute. First move?

label.zh: 比對各個報價來源
label.en: Compare the price sources

say.zh: 五個報價來源裡只有一家報 52,000，其他四家都在 63,000 附近；指數取平均，被這一家拉了下來。
say.en: One of five sources reports 52,000; the other four are around 63,000. The index averages them, so the one dragged it down.

label.zh: 等等看價格會不會自己回來
label.en: Wait and see whether the price comes back

say.zh: 價格一直沒回來。閃兌照著錯的指數報價，一直有人用低價買 BTC。
say.en: It doesn't come back. Convert keeps quoting from the wrong index, and people keep buying BTC cheap.

label.zh: 叫醒交易組的同事
label.en: Wake the trading team

say.zh: 交易組的同事：「先比對各家報價。」你一比，只有一家在亂跳。
say.en: The trading lead: "Compare the sources." Only one of them is off.

label.zh: 重啟報價服務
label.en: Restart the pricing service

say.zh: 重啟後指數一樣被那一家拉低：它的 API 還在回錯價。
say.en: After the restart the index is dragged down the same way: that source's API is still returning the bad price.

label.zh: 全站進入維護，所有交易暫停
label.en: Put the whole exchange into maintenance and halt trading

say.zh: 錯價不會再成交了，但所有用戶都不能交易，社群一片問號。
say.en: No more fills at the wrong price, but nobody can trade, and social media fills with question marks.

ask.zh: 確定是單一報價來源出錯。
ask.en: It's one bad price source.

label.zh: 先暫停 BTC 閃兌
label.en: Pause BTC convert first

say.zh: 錯價不會再被拿來成交了，但想正常閃兌的用戶也被擋住了。
say.en: No more fills at the wrong price, but users who just want to convert are blocked too.

label.zh: 把出錯的來源移出指數，加上離群值過濾
label.en: Drop the bad source from the index and add outlier filtering

say.zh: 改設定、重新部署花了 8 分鐘。指數回到 63,000 附近，閃兌恢復正常報價。
say.en: The config change and redeploy take 8 minutes. The index is back near 63,000 and convert quotes normally.

label.zh: 指數改成只看最大的那家交易所
label.en: Switch the index to the single largest exchange

say.zh: 馬上恢復正常。但只剩一個來源、沒有備援，下次那一家出錯就沒救了。
say.en: Normal again at once. But with one source and no backup, the next glitch there goes straight through.

label.zh: 手動把指數價格固定在 63,000
label.en: Pin the index price at 63,000 by hand

say.zh: 閃兌恢復了，只是真實價格一動，你固定的價格就變成新的錯價，你得一直盯著改。
say.en: Convert works again, but the moment the real price moves your pinned one becomes the new wrong price, and you have to keep adjusting it.

ask.zh: 指數回到 63,000 附近了。閃兌怎麼恢復？
ask.en: The index is back near 63,000. How do you bring convert back?

label.zh: 先用小額實際下單測報價，確認各來源一致再開放
label.en: Test quotes with small real orders and confirm the sources agree before reopening

say.zh: 小額測試的報價都在市價 0.1% 內，開放閃兌。
say.en: Test quotes land within 0.1% of market; convert reopens.

label.zh: 直接開放
label.en: Just reopen it

say.zh: 開放後才發現報價還有一點偏差，又有幾筆成交偏離了 3%。
say.en: After reopening you find quotes still slightly off, and a few more fills land 3% away.

ask.zh: 價格恢復正常了。錯價期間成交的單怎麼處理？
ask.en: Prices are normal again. What about the fills at the wrong price?

label.zh: 依用戶條款回滾明顯錯價的成交，逐一通知用戶
label.en: Reverse the clearly mispriced fills under the terms of service and tell each user

say.zh: 依條款回滾偏離市價的成交，逐一通知受影響的用戶並說明原因。有人抱怨，但帳是對的。
say.en: The off-market fills are reversed under the terms and every affected user gets an explanation. Some complain, but the books are right.

label.zh: 全部認賠，不回滾
label.en: Absorb the loss, reverse nothing

say.zh: 用戶都開心，公司吞下這筆損失。
say.en: Users are happy; the company eats the loss.

label.zh: 直接回滾，不另外通知
label.en: Reverse them without telling anyone

say.zh: 用戶打開 App，發現剛買的 BTC 不見了，社群上一片罵聲。
say.en: Users open the app to find the BTC they just bought is gone, and social media erupts.

label.zh: 只回滾偏離超過 10% 的成交，其餘認賠，並通知受影響的用戶
label.en: Reverse only fills more than 10% off, absorb the rest, and tell those affected

say.zh: 偏離大的依條款回滾並通知，小幅偏離的公司吸收。客訴少了一些，損失也還能接受。
say.en: The big misses are reversed under the terms with notice; the small ones the company absorbs. Fewer complaints, and a loss the company can live with.

ask.zh: 收尾：
ask.en: Clean-up:

label.zh: 發公告說明錯價原因與處理方式，給客服回覆範本
label.en: Publish what went wrong with the price and how it's being handled, with a reply template for support

say.zh: 社群上還是有人抱怨，但大家知道發生什麼事、會怎麼處理。
say.en: There's still grumbling, but people know what happened and what happens next.

label.zh: 不公告，個別問再個別回
label.en: No announcement; answer people one by one

say.zh: 社群開始流傳「交易所偷偷改單」的說法，客服一個一個解釋到中午。
say.en: A rumour that the exchange quietly altered trades spreads, and support explains it one by one until noon.

cause.zh: 指數價格由五個報價來源平均而來，沒有過濾離群值。其中一家的 API 回了錯誤的成交價，指數被拉低 18%，閃兌照著這個指數報價，有人趁機低價買進。
cause.en: The index averaged five price sources with no outlier filter. One source's API returned a bad trade price, dragging the index down 18%; convert quoted from that index and some people bought cheap.

todo.zh: 指數用中位數或加權並過濾離群值，單一來源拉不動指數
todo.en: Use a median or weighted index with outlier filtering, so no single source can move it

todo.zh: 價格短時間劇烈變動時自動暫停閃兌，等人工確認
todo.en: Pause convert automatically on sharp moves until someone confirms

todo.zh: 用戶條款寫清楚錯價成交的處理方式，事發時照條款走並通知
todo.en: State in the terms how mispriced fills are handled, and follow them with notice when it happens

lesson.zh: 價格是交易所的命脈：任何一個來源都不該能單獨改變它；出事時先止血，再照規則處理。
lesson.en: Price is an exchange's lifeline: no single source should be able to move it. Stop the bleeding first, then follow the rules.
